narr: A cold front draped from the Mid-Atlantic states into the Ohio Valley tracked southward in the evening and overnight hours, moving through northern portions of central North Carolina. Ahead of the front, storms fired along central to eastern sections of central North Carolina. Embedded stronger storms developed over the Triangle region in the afternoon hours, producing heavy rainfall and flash flooding across Wake County.
